method: Population: the 57 graded rows of coverage-d34.json. Draw: scripts/measure-audit-sample.mjs, seed d11:shell-scenarios:d34, 50 of 57, stratified by verdict (29 partly_covered, 12 covered, 9 not_covered). Per row: scenario values, observed series and definition against the edition's own base-year values and the realized.json notes, EI 2026 values re-read from the workbook (Shell .xlsb values not re-read), year, verdict. Basis gaps that could move a verdict are recorded as threshold flags (#66), not errors. Findings are fixed for every row in scripts/scenario-coverage-d34.mjs; coverage-d34.json counts fixed and residual findings as data/graded/audit does (#53).
